name: lintassist
description: Static site — source lives in public/, copied to dist/ for Cloudflare Pages (project's configured output directory).

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R public/. dist/
scripts.build:marketing: rm -rf marketing-dist && mkdir -p marketing-dist && cp public/marketing.html marketing-dist/index.html && cp public/logo.png public/privacy.html public/releases.html marketing-dist/
